headline: Pop Mart Shares Drop 6% in Hong Kong as Cooling Demand Weighs on Q3 Sales
summary: Shares of Pop Mart dropped 6% in Hong Kong trading after a sharp decline in third-quarter revenue growth pointed to waning consumer demand for its signature Labubu product line.
why: Pop Mart is a prominent Chinese designer toy and collectible retailer that has relied heavily on viral intellectual property franchises to sustain high gross margins.

impacts.name: Pop Mart International Group
impacts.why: A rapid slowdown in quarterly sales of flagship toys undermines growth forecasts and drives a valuation re-rating.

why_moved: Shares slid 6% after third-quarter figures confirmed a significant drop in retail sales momentum as popular product hype receded.
